content_fr: Avant de tuer stuck-worker : ps -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,args= -p "$(cat /run/lpic/healthy-worker.pid),$(cat /run/lpic/stuck-worker.pid)" > /run/lpic/process-inspection. Lance ensuite /usr/local/bin/lpic-signal-probe au premier plan, Ctrl-Z, jobs, bg, kill -TERM sur son PID. Enfin : nohup /usr/local/bin/resilient-worker >/run/lpic/resilient.log 2>&1 & ; tmux new-session -d -s ops.
